rules.style: Plain, conversational American English. Short sentences, concrete facts.

hooks.name: why_it_matters
hooks.pattern: State the fact, then explain its practical consequence.
hooks.example: This update changes the default setting. Check compatibility before upgrading.

hooks.name: practical_takeaway
hooks.pattern: Open with a practical takeaway supported by the source.
hooks.example: Before using this feature, check whether your device supports it.
